articles.summary: CHAPEL HILL, N.C., July 31, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- James River Group Holdings, Inc. ("James River" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: JRVR) will release second quarter earnings after the market closes on Monday, August 10, 2026. It will also host an earnings conference call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026,
articles.title: James River to Hold Its Second Quarter Earnings Conference Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
